/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 -B -c 'from solution import reconcile
cases=[(\"tie\",[{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":1,\"payload\":\"first\"},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":1,\"payload\":\"last\"}],{\"a\":\"last\"}),(\"stale delete\",[{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":2,\"payload\":\"new\"},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":1,\"deleted\":True}],{\"a\":\"new\"}),(\"older revival\",[{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":2,\"deleted\":True},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":1,\"payload\":\"old\"}],{}),(\"empty\",[],{}),(\"one pass\",iter([{\"entity\":\" A \",\"version\":0,\"payload\":None}]),{\" A \":None})]
for name,events,expected in cases:
 actual=reconcile(events); print(name, \"PASS\" if actual==expected else \"FAIL\",repr(actual))
invalid=[None,{}, {\"entity\":\"\",\"version\":0,\"payload\":1},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":True,\"payload\":1},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":-1,\"payload\":1},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":1.5,\"payload\":1},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":0,\"deleted\":1},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":0},{\"entity\":3,\"version\":0,\"payload\":1}]
for event in invalid:
 try: reconcile([event]); outcome=\"accepted\"
 except Exception as e: outcome=type(e).__name__
 print(\"validation\",repr(event),outcome)
try:
 reconcile([{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":2,\"payload\":1},{\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":1}]); print(\"stale missing payload: accepted\")
except Exception as e: print(\"stale missing payload:\",type(e).__name__)
payload={\"nested\":[]}; event={\"entity\":\"a\",\"version\":0,\"payload\":payload}; result=reconcile([event]); print(\"payload aliased:\",result[\"a\"] is payload,\"nested aliased:\",result[\"a\"][\"nested\"] is payload[\"nested\"])
'"
